adjectives.definition: dynamic, energetic (of a person or style)
ruined or in very bad condition
experienced or established in a field

douer.note: Douer is uncommon; doué is widely used as an adjective meaning gifted.

adjectives.definition: sticky; clingy (of a person or substance)
creative, able to invent new things
flattering (of clothing or color); that enhances appearance
sociable, easy to get along with
biting or scathing (as in a remark or wind)
able to foresee or plan ahead
